blurb: Welcome to Indian Creek Golf Course, your number one option for a round of golf in Hood River, Oregon. We are centrally located just 50 miles east of Portland International Airport in Oregon’s Mid-Columbia region. Just follow the waterfalls along the Columbia River on I-84 East and you’ll soon enter into the first National Scenic Area in the United States.
